definitions: A schedule distributed to the cast and crew of a film, television show, or commercial production, detailing the shooting schedule, locations, and other important information for a specific day.
A document used in theater or film production that lists the cast and crew members required on set for a particular day, along with their call times and other relevant details.
examples: Check the call sheet for tomorrow's location.
The assistant director distributed the call sheet.
My call time is on the call sheet.
